messages:
maria: heads up — samplekit CI failing on typegen regen after the custom serializer change. regen diff is huge and it's blocking the release.

jake: ouch, which change exactly? semver minor or patch?

tess: looks like we reordered the default output from `serialize()` so snapshots show big diffs. tests blow up.

maria: exact CI snippet: 
```
Regendiff detected: sampleapp/src/serializers.py
-  "fields": ["b", "a"]
+  "fields": ["a", "b"]
```

alen: did typegen get a version bump? any CHANGELOG/notice?

maria: lockfile shows typegen 1.8.2 -> 1.9.0 but no changelog entry in release PR.

ci-bot: pipeline #4521 failed: regendiff-check (see logs: https://ci.redwood/4521)

deploy-bot: quick mitigation: you can pin sampleapp to typegen@1.8.2 in samplekit manifest to unblock releases.

jake: pinning is fine short term. need a decision on semver policy though — reorder seems like behavior change. probably minor.

tess: it's an internal ordering change; in principle consumers shouldn't rely on ordering, but some sample apps and SDKs do. that's a breaking change for them.

sam: my proposal: revert ordering in a patch release to restore compatibility, then ship a minor that documents the new ordering and adds an opt-in flag for stable ordering.

maria: I'll open a revert PR and pin samplekit. can someone add CHANGES.md entry for typegen?

leo: I'll add changelog note + regen-note in the release checklist and mark this as release-blocker.

jake: also add a regression test asserting stable snapshot ordering so this doesn't silently slip again.

maria: created PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/789 (revert) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/456 (pin). kicking CI.

ci-bot: pipeline #4522 started (rebuild after pin/revert).

ci-bot: pipeline #4522 passed — pin workaround validated, regendiff-check skipped when pinned.

tess: follow-up action: we should write a short devex doc "Serializer ordering & typegen semver guidance" and add it to the devex onboarding checklist. I'll draft a PR.

maria: thanks everyone :heart: leaving this thread in #devex for traceability.
